principle: Unify semantics and receipts before moving bytes. Existing stores remain rollback authorities until each phase passes equivalence/replay/fault gates.

phases.name: INVENTORY_AND_IDENTITY
actions: enumerate actual FRANK stores/data classes without inventing stores
assign canonical Clay resource/object IDs
classify authority vs derived vs isolated
record valid/transaction time and provenance gaps
phases.gate: 100% of effect-critical state has explicit authority and replay owner

phases.name: UNIFIED_QUERY_SHADOW
actions: introduce ClayCode UnifiedQueryIR above existing stores
emit query-plan/selection receipts
run old and new query paths in shadow
compare exact result sets/rankings and latency
phases.gate: exact/effect-critical query equivalence plus bounded declared differences for approximate routes

phases.name: CANONICAL_EVENT_SPINE_SHADOW
actions: dual-record immutable operation/event receipts into candidate authoritative spine
do not change current release authority
replay candidate state and compare hashes/invariants
phases.rollback: discard candidate spine; existing authority untouched

phases.name: DURABLE_DERIVATION_LOG
actions: bind graph/vector/FTS/activation updates to canonical event IDs
use durable outbox/derivation receipts
measure lag/replay/rebuild
inject failures before/after sidecar updates
phases.gate: no silent derived divergence; replay converges; stale status explicit

phases.name: COGNITIVE_STATE_CONTINUITY_SHADOW
actions: allow event deltas to update latent activation between LLM calls in shadow
construct Assembly-ready frontier
compare automatic activation vs explicit retrieval and no-memory control
keep activation non-authoritative
phases.gate: improved task/memory metrics without false-association/authority regressions; GWT stage orthogonality maintained
phases.rollback: disable background activation; explicit retrieval remains

phases.name: AUTHORITATIVE_CUTOVER_CANDIDATE
actions: select one authoritative effect-critical commit domain only after live replay/fault evidence
keep capabilities/secrets isolated
retain old read-only replay path
version all planner/derivation semantics
phases.gate: live/twin correctness, p99, crash recovery, effect atomicity, operational rollback
phases.rollback: restore old authoritative path from preserved event boundary

phases.name: PHYSICAL_COLOCATION_EXPERIMENTS
actions: benchmark candidate subplans for colocation
measure serialization savings vs contention/write amplification/recovery/common-mode risk
test Linux and Android/edge lowerings separately
phases.gate: co-location beats specialized route on target Pareto frontier without correctness/recovery regression
phases.rollback: restore specialized adapter for that subplan

default_keep_isolated: raw external source blobs where not hot
external systems whose transaction semantics cannot join effect-critical commit safely
hard_stop_conditions: selection receipt missing for consequential ranked retrieval
